title_zh: 多哥部长会议主席福雷向人民英雄纪念碑敬献花圈
title_en: Togo's Council of Ministers President Faure Lays Wreath at Monument to the People's Heroes
summary_zh: 10月13日下午，多哥部长会议主席福雷前往北京天安门广场，向人民英雄纪念碑敬献花圈。
summary_en: On the afternoon of October 13, Faure, President of Togo's Council of Ministers, visited Tiananmen Square in Beijing and laid a wreath at the Monument to the People's Heroes.
